notes.pitch_positivity: C is overwhelmingly celebratory and upbeat, placing it first. D maintains a constant, bright smile. E is positive and passionate. B is slightly more serious. A is flat and rehearsed.
notes.expressed_enthusiasm: C's presenters are visibly thrilled and highly animated. E shows deep, engaged passion. B is very animated. D is earnest but more measured. A is stiff and lacks genuine excitement.
notes.interpersonal_warmth: E's heartfelt gestures and welcoming demeanor make him most approachable. D is exceptionally polite with a gentle smile. C is friendly but highly intense. B is relatable. A is stiff.
